tools.name: validate_target
tools.description: FREE. Check that a domain/hostname is well-formed before paying for a check. Returns the normalized host.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: FREE. Prices, network and payment address for the paid tools.

tools.name: check_cert
tools.description: Certificate status for a hostname from Certificate Transparency logs (issuer, validity, days left, % lifetime used, renewal cadence, renewal-stall heuristic) plus a live HTTPS pass/fail probe. Cert details come from CT logs, not the live connection.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Live DNS via DoH: NS, A/AAAA/CNAME, MX, SPF, DMARC, CAA (tree-climbing), DNSSEC, with plain-English findings.

tools.name: check_domain_expiry
tools.description: Domain registration expiry via RDAP: registrar, registered/expires dates, days left, status, nameservers.

tools.name: site_health
tools.description: Bundle: check_cert + check_dns + check_domain_expiry with a summary, the renewal-stall heuristic and the Let's Encrypt 64-day (2027-02-10) note.
